document: KJ Genesis Funder Key Utility Policy
eligibilitySignal: Current ERC-721 ownership unless a benefit is explicitly marked as token-consumable.

benefits.description: Eligibility for an equal per-token share of a proposed 5% founder pool funded from specifically defined Merchant Mystery Box mint and node-upgrade receipts.
benefits.mechanic: Epoch snapshot and claim; exact gross/net basis, currencies, exclusions, taxes, custody, timing, and buyer jurisdictions must be defined before activation.

benefits.description: 1.5x Project KJ node reward multiplier while the operating wallet verifies current ownership.
benefits.mechanic: Continuous ownership check; cannot stack with another Funder Key unless future published terms explicitly allow it.

benefits.description: Zero Project KJ platform commission for eligible marketplace activities while ownership is verified.
benefits.mechanic: Continuous ownership check; payment-network fees, gas, taxes, chargebacks, third-party fees, and legally required deductions are excluded.

benefits.description: One Merchant Mystery Box claim per Funder token ID.
benefits.mechanic: Token-consumable entitlement recorded by token ID; transfer after a claim does not restore it.

benefits.description: Proposed doubled KJ Genesis and KJ Global draw weight, with KJ Pioneer as the minimum tier for an eligible Funder claim.
benefits.mechanic: Must be enforced and publicly testable in the future VRF-backed Merchant Box contract; exact probability table must be published before sale.

benefits.description: Priority invitation for the first Project KJ IOTA-compatible pilot hardware wave.
benefits.mechanic: Token-consumable reservation; shipping territory, identity, duties, taxes, availability, and delivery terms remain to be published.
